change_rule: Numbers change only through a recorded change-log entry made before the evaluation that uses them; never after seeing held-out results.

hook_process_peak_working_set_mib.method: GetProcessMemoryInfo at exit; capsule ensure / vmem hot-context / autoinject shadow on a copy of the live corpus

hook_process_wall_ms_median.method: 15 interleaved paired spawns, warm OS cache

cascade_retrieve_ms_median_in_process.method: 40 calls, same corpus copy (116 memories), unique query per call on the miss path

budgets.background_brain_processes_per_prompt: NOT_MEASURED (ledger mirror, P4 pulse and environment spawns are fire-and-forget; count them before freezing a limit)

storage_mib.note: state/telemetry sessions also bounded by config/session-retention.toml (100 MiB per session, 1 GiB total)

budgets.default_profile_dependencies: no daemon, no GPU, no network service, no model call to decide whether to use memory

quality_margins.PERF-01_no_benefit: Every no-benefit run: zero brain.* custom messages AND provider-counted input tokens equal to the native arm under matched cwd path length. Any positive delta fails.
quality_margins.PERF-01_false_abstention: Concise memory-needing cases deliver the required memory in at least as many runs as the M00 arm.
quality_margins.RET-02_named_dilution: Named concise/instruction-heavy pairs: required memory recovered in 100% of deterministic regression runs; a genuinely appended constraint changes the selected set.
quality_margins.ARCH-01_lifecycle: Zero Brain-returned stop/continue/cancel decisions in any adapter hook output.
quality_margins.PERF-02_pre_dispatch: Candidate median (launch -> user message_end) minus inert-arm median must not exceed M00's delta; reaching the 100 ms p95 cold target is the E01 comparison's job.
quality_margins.semantic_retrieval_E02: Not yet declared; must be frozen here before any S2 held-out run.
